evidence.excerpt: This paper presents GENAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0, the third iteration of an evaluation framework to assess Generative AI tools for creating Interactive Digital Narratives (IDNs).

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Moving beyond manual testing, this iteration introduces AI-assisted evaluation through a publicly accessible web application (https://genai4idn.com), enabling the community to run benchmarks on demand, add new models, and propose new tasks.
